_note: CELL SCHEMA for the BUILD_SPEC four-agent pipeline. Per subdomain: RADICALS (difficulty-determining axes the harness pins to a band via the LLTM) vs INCIDENTALS (surface axes the harness draws randomly for variety). The LLTM (additive, hand-set weights — Embretson/Gierl; you FIT these, you don't derive them) maps a radical vector to a 200-800 scale score, bucketed to a band by the official Skills-Insight cut scores. Start: linear_equations_one_variable only (BUILD_SPEC build order step 1).

band_cuts._note: lower edge (scale score) of each band; score < first edge => B1

lltm._note: predicted_difficulty = w0 + n_steps*ws + both_sides + distribution + fractions + answer_is_fraction. Ordered by intuition (fractions and steps weigh most). Refit against measured consistency-difficulty in BUILD_SPEC step 5.
